sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
Correct, the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers BR-225 and only shows Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B) for it. It has no approval for Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) on BR-225 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR. The re-audit restored the company status only. It does not approve any part.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source, a change of material, a change of manufacturing process, or a change

findings.why: BR-225 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual is in force and replaces revision 3. It requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipping after a change of source. No Aurelia approval is on file.

sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.
cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.

findings.why: Chisone has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. BR-225 is drawn in EN AW-6082-T6, so the open issue applies to this part.

sources.quote: SC-BR225-YS,BR-225,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250

findings.why: The drawing requires EN AW-6082-T6 with yield of at least 250 MPa. Chisone is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. The material master gives typical yield of 240 MPa for 6061-T6 and 230 MPa for 6082-T5, both below 250 MPa. Chisone has no capability for the drawing material.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for

findings.why: Chisone has 3.1 certificates only for MAT-6061-T6 and MAT-6082-T5. There is none for MAT-6082-T6, the drawing material of BR-225. The supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo) must clarify.
